_comment: Proofs are device-issued. The device mints them with its user and attestation keys, which Speculos regenerates on every boot unless pinned, so SpeculinhoServiceController pins them (--user-private-key, --attestation-key, --deterministic-rng) to keep these valid across pods. Recorded from a `tron:contacts-register` run; re-record them there if the pinned identity, the seed or the device changes.
